content: STOMP over WebSocket (Spring's spring-boot-starter-websocket + @EnableWebSocketMessageBroker) is recommended over raw WebSocket for broadcast-style 'session/lobby' updates because it adds topic-based routing (/topic, /queue) and pub/sub semantics via SimpMessagingTemplate, saving significant custom routing code for room/session broadcast use cases. Raw WebSocket is lighter but requires hand-rolled message framing/routing. SockJS fallback is unnecessary for modern browsers targeting only WebSocket-capable clients.
